uv run python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, calinski_harabasz_score, davies_bouldin_score
d=np.genfromtxt('data/line_modes.csv',delimiter=',',names=True)
cols=['temp_c','vibration_mm_s','pressure_kpa','flow_lpm','current_a','speed_rpm']
X=np.column_stack([d[c] for c in cols])
Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
p=PCA().fit(Xs)
print("explained",np.round(p.explained_variance_ratio_,3),"cum",np.round(np.cumsum(p.explained_variance_ratio_),3))
Z=p.transform(Xs)
print("PC loadings")
for i,c in enumerate(cols): print(c, np.round(p.components_[:,i],2))
print("\nkmeans")
for k in range(2,9):
    km=KMeans(k,n_init=20,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
    print(k, "inertia %.1f"%km.inertia_, "sil %.3f"%silhouette_score(Xs,km.labels_), "CH %.0f"%calinski_harabasz_score(Xs,km.labels_), "DB %.3f"%davies_bouldin_score(Xs,km.labels_), "sizes",np.bincount(km.labels_))
print("\ngmm BIC")
for k in range(1,9):
    g=GaussianMixture(k,n_init=10,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
    print(k,"BIC %.1f"%g.bic(Xs),"AIC %.1f"%g.aic(Xs),"sil %.3f"%silhouette_score(Xs,g.predict(Xs)) if k>1 else "")
PY

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, adjusted_rand_score
d=np.genfromtxt('data/line_modes.csv',delimiter=',',names=True)
cols=['temp_c','vibration_mm_s','pressure_kpa','flow_lpm','current_a','speed_rpm']
X=np.column_stack([d[c] for c in cols]); Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
for k in [8,9,10]:
    labs=[]
    for s in range(20):
        labs.append(KMeans(k,n_init=10,random_state=s).fit_predict(Xs))
    aris=[adjusted_rand_score(labs[0],l) for l in labs[1:]]
    print("k",k,"seed ARI mean/min %.3f/%.3f"%(np.mean(aris),np.min(aris)))
km=KMeans(9,n_init=50,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
order=np.argsort(km.cluster_centers_[:,0])
print("\nk=9 centers (original units), size")
for j in order:
    c=km.cluster_centers_[j]*X.std(0)+X.mean(0)
    print("cluster",j,"n=%3d"%np.sum(km.labels_==j),np.round(c,2))
print("\nper-cluster within-SD")
for j in order:
    print(j, np.round(X[km.labels_==j].std(0),2))
PY

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture
d=np.genfromtxt('data/line_modes.csv',delimiter=',',names=True)
cols=['temp_c','vibration_mm_s','pressure_kpa','flow_lpm','current_a','speed_rpm']
X=np.column_stack([d[c] for c in cols]); Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
km9=KMeans(9,n_init=50,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
big=np.where(km9.labels_==1)[0]
sub=X[big]
print("big cluster n",len(big))
for i,c in enumerate(cols):
    q=np.percentile(sub[:,i],[0,25,50,75,100])
    print(c,np.round(q,1))
# k=10 split of big cluster
km10=KMeans(10,n_init=50,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
from collections import Counter
print("k10 labels for big:",Counter(km10.labels_[big]))

    c=km10.cluster_centers_[j]*X.std(0)+X.mean(0)

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, adjusted_rand_score
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture

d=np.genfromtxt('data/line_modes.csv',delimiter=',',names=True)
cols=['temp_c','vibration_mm_s','pressure_kpa','flow_lpm','current_a','speed_rpm']
X=np.column_stack([d[c] for c in cols]); Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
ks=range(2,13); sils=[silhouette_score(Xs,KMeans(k,n_init=20,random_state=0).fit_predict(Xs)) for k in ks]
km=KMeans(9,n_init=50,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
gm=GaussianMixture(9,n_init=20,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
print("ARI kmeans vs gmm9",adjusted_rand_score(km.labels_,gm.predict(Xs)))
p=PCA(2).fit(Xs); Z=p.transform(Xs)
order=np.argsort(km.cluster_centers_[:,0])
remap={old:new for new,old in enumerate(order)}
lab=np.array([remap[l] for l in km.labels_])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.5))
for j in range(9):
    m=lab==j
    ax[0].scatter(Z[m,0],Z[m,1],s=14,alpha=.75,label=f"M{j+1} (n={m.sum()})")
ax[0].set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({p.explained_variance_ratio_[0]*100:.0f}%)")
ax[0].set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({p.explained_variance_ratio_[1]*100:.0f}%)")
ax[0].set_title("Operating modes (k=9, KMeans)")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7,ncol=2); ax[0].grid(alpha=.25)
ax[1].plot(list(ks),sils,'o-')
ax[1].axvline(9,color='r',ls='--',alpha=.5)
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of clusters k"); ax[1].set_ylabel("silhouette score")
ax[1].set_title("Model selection"); ax[1].grid(alpha=.25)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('figs/line_modes_clusters.png',dpi=150)
print("saved figs/line_modes_clusters.png")
print("sil",dict(zip(ks,np.round(sils,3))))
print("\nprofiles sorted by temp")
for j in range(9):
    c=X[lab==j].mean(0); n=(lab==j).sum()
    print(f"M{j+1} n={n:3d} | temp {c[0]:5.1f} | vib {c[1]:4.2f} | pres {c[2]:5.1f} | flow {c[3]:5.1f} | cur {c[4]:5.2f} | rpm {c[5]:6.0f}")
PY
